scenes.visual: Dark navy canvas (#0F172A). Large high-contrast title 'Hedgehog Releases a Brake' in crisp white (size 48) centered above a subtle glowing horizontal band of schematic embryonic cells that gently shimmers as the title fades out.

scenes.tts: How can one secreted signal tell embryonic cells what to become? And why does it work by switching off a brake? Most pathways you know add an active signal. Hedgehog instead removes a brake.
scenes.caption: How can one secreted signal tell embryonic cells what to become? And why does it work by switching off a brake? Most pathways you know add an active signal. Hedgehog instead removes a brake.
scenes.visual: Carried world opens at 70% frame height: a row of six schematic embryonic cells along the bottom, with a warm-gold (#F5A623) source cell on the left pulsing softly. Gold Hedgehog spheres drift rightward across the row. Above the cells, a brief schematic toggle flashes: an 'ON' switch being flipped by removing a coral-red (#E05A47) brake block rather than pressing a green button.
scenes.narration: How can one secreted signal tell embryonic cells what to become? And why does it work by switching off a brake? Most pathways you know add an active signal. Hedgehog instead removes a brake.

scenes.tts: Start across this row of developing cells. The source on the left releases Hedgehog, which spreads outward and fades with distance. Near cells see a high dose for longer, while distant cells see less. Each cell converts that reading into a distinct fate. Because concentration and duration steer cell identity, Hedgehog is a morphogen.
scenes.caption: Start across this row of developing cells. The source on the left releases Hedgehog, which spreads outward and fades with distance. Near cells see a high dose for longer, while distant cells see less. Each cell converts that reading into a distinct fate. Because concentration and duration steer cell identity, Hedgehog is a morphogen.
scenes.visual: Same row of cells. Warm-gold (#F5A623) Hedgehog spheres diffuse rightward as a smooth declining concentration curve (labelled 'schematic gradient') draws across the top. A small time bar fills steadily while near cells shift tint to bright gold-teal, middle cells to medium teal, and far cells remain slate. Label (size 30): 'Morphogen: dose + duration'.
scenes.narration: Start across this row of developing cells. The source on the left releases Hedgehog, which spreads outward and fades with distance. Near cells see a high dose for longer, while distant cells see less. Each cell converts that reading into a distinct fate. Because concentration and duration steer cell identity, Hedgehog is a morphogen.

scenes.tts: Now zoom into the membrane of one receiving cell. Two membrane proteins run the switch: Patched and Smoothened. Without Hedgehog, Patched stays active and holds Smoothened off. Notice that Patched never touches Smoothened. A single Patched molecule can keep many Smoothened molecules quiet from a distance.
scenes.caption: Now zoom into the membrane of one receiving cell. Two membrane proteins run the switch: Patched and Smoothened. Without Hedgehog, Patched stays active and holds Smoothened off. Notice that Patched never touches Smoothened. A single Patched molecule can keep many Smoothened molecules quiet from a distance.
scenes.visual: Smooth camera zoom into the third cell, filling 70% of the frame: plasma membrane across the upper third, nucleus dome along the bottom. Embedded in the membrane: one coral-red (#E05A47) block labelled 'Patched' sitting clearly separated from three dim grey-teal (#2AB7CA at low brightness) blocks labelled 'Smoothened (OFF)'. Soft pulsing coral ripples radiate outward from Patched while the three Smoothened blocks stay clearly apart and unlinked.
scenes.narration: Now zoom into the membrane of one receiving cell. Two membrane proteins run the switch: Patched and Smoothened. Without Hedgehog, Patched stays active and holds Smoothened off. Notice that Patched never touches Smoothened. A single Patched molecule can keep many Smoothened molecules quiet from a distance.

scenes.tts: How can a brake work without grabbing its target? Patched resembles a membrane transporter. In the leading model, Smoothened needs a sterol, likely cholesterol, to turn on. Active Patched keeps that sterol out of reach. What Patched actually moves, and what powers it, remain open questions.
scenes.caption: How can a brake work without grabbing its target? Patched resembles a membrane transporter. In the leading model, Smoothened needs a sterol, likely cholesterol, to turn on. Active Patched keeps that sterol out of reach. What Patched actually moves, and what powers it, remain open questions.
scenes.visual: Same cell membrane cross-section. Small glowing amber (#FFD166) oval tokens labelled 'sterol? (schematic)' drift in the bilayer. The coral-red Patched transporter actively sweeps amber tokens away from the membrane around the three dim teal Smoothened blocks, leaving a dark sterol-poor halo around Smoothened. Corner tag (size 28): 'Proposed sterol model (schematic)'.
scenes.narration: How can a brake work without grabbing its target? Patched resembles a membrane transporter. In the leading model, Smoothened needs a sterol, likely cholesterol, to turn on. Active Patched keeps that sterol out of reach. What Patched actually moves, and what powers it, remain open questions.

scenes.tts: Now Hedgehog arrives and binds Patched. Hedgehog carries lipid tails, and one plugs into Patched, switching the brake off. In the model, accessible sterol now reaches Smoothened, which lights up and turns on. Hedgehog never pressed an accelerator. It switched off an off-switch, which is why the pathway is a double negative.
scenes.caption: Now Hedgehog arrives and binds Patched. Hedgehog carries lipid tails, and one plugs into Patched, switching the brake off. In the model, accessible sterol now reaches Smoothened, which lights up and turns on. Hedgehog never pressed an accelerator. It switched off an off-switch, which is why the pathway is a double negative.
scenes.visual: Same membrane scene. A warm-gold (#F5A623) Hedgehog sphere with two short lipid tails docks onto coral-red Patched, sliding one tail into Patched's top groove. Patched dims to muted coral and stops sweeping. Amber (#FFD166) sterol tokens drift smoothly into the teal Smoothened blocks, which brighten to vivid glowing teal (#2AB7CA) labelled 'Smoothened (ON)'. Compact logic line fades in at top: 'Hedgehog -| Patched -| Smoothened'. Empathy fix: Briefly label the two tails 'Lipid tails' as they are named.
scenes.narration: Now Hedgehog arrives and binds Patched. Hedgehog carries lipid tails, and one plugs into Patched, switching the brake off. In the model, accessible sterol now reaches Smoothened, which lights up and turns on. Hedgehog never pressed an accelerator. It switched off an off-switch, which is why the pathway is a double negative.

scenes.tts: What does Smoothened control inside the cell? Follow the transcription factor called Glee. While Smoothened is off, kinases add phosphates to Glee, marking it for the proteasome. The proteasome shreds only its back activating half. The front D N A binding piece survives and silences target genes as a repressor.
scenes.caption: What does Smoothened control inside the cell? Follow the transcription factor called Gli. While Smoothened is off, kinases add phosphates to Gli, marking it for the proteasome. The proteasome shreds only its back activating half. The front DNA-binding piece survives and silences target genes as a repressor.
scenes.visual: Camera pans slightly down inside the same cell (membrane still visible at top with Hedgehog gone, Patched bright coral, Smoothened dim grey-teal). A two-part violet bar labelled 'Gli' drifts into view: deep-violet (#6B46C1) front half ('DNA-binding') joined to bright-lavender (#C4B5FD) back half ('activator'). A slate-blue (#6C8EBF) kinase complex dots small phosphate beads onto Gli; a slate-blue proteasome cylinder pulls in the lavender back end and dissolves it into fading specks. The intact deep-violet front piece glides into the nucleus, locks onto a gene bar, and dims it to 'Genes OFF'.
scenes.narration: What does Smoothened control inside the cell? Follow the transcription factor called Gli. While Smoothened is off, kinases add phosphates to Gli, marking it for the proteasome. The proteasome shreds only its back activating half. The front DNA-binding piece survives and silences target genes as a repressor.

scenes.tts: Now pause and predict. Hedgehog arrives, Patched switches off, and Smoothened turns on. Does the cell glue cut repressors back together, or spare newly made Glee from being cut?
scenes.caption: Now pause and predict. Hedgehog arrives, Patched switches off, and Smoothened turns on. Does the cell glue cut repressors back together, or spare newly made Gli from being cut?
scenes.visual: Same cell cross-section. Gold Hedgehog docks on Patched; Smoothened lights bright teal at the top. In the cytosol below, two dashed schematic paths appear side by side: Path A shows a deep-violet cut repressor piece next to faded fragments with a '?' icon ('Glue back?'); Path B shows a fresh full-length violet-lavender Gli bar approaching the kinase complex with a '?' icon ('Spare full-length?'). Clear bold question banner at top (size 30): 'Glue cut repressors, or spare new Gli?'
scenes.narration: Now pause and predict. Hedgehog arrives, Patched switches off, and Smoothened turns on. Does the cell glue cut repressors back together, or spare newly made Gli from being cut?

scenes.visual: Deliberate thinking pause. Question banner 'Glue cut repressors, or spare new Gli?' stays crisp on screen while a thin calm countdown ring fills slowly over 4.5 seconds and both dashed options gently pulse.

scenes.tts: It spares newly made Glee from cutting. Once Smoothened turns on, kinase marking stops. Cut repressors are never glued back together. Instead, freshly made Glee avoids the proteasome, keeps its activating half intact, and moves into the nucleus whole. There, full-length Glee switches target genes on.
scenes.caption: It spares newly made Gli from cutting. Once Smoothened turns on, kinase marking stops. Cut repressors are never glued back together. Instead, freshly made Gli avoids the proteasome, keeps its activating half intact, and moves into the nucleus whole. There, full-length Gli switches target genes on.
scenes.visual: Path A gently fades away with a clean grey cross-out. The slate-blue kinase complex dims and steps back from the path. The fresh intact violet-lavender Gli bar glides smoothly past the idle proteasome, enters the nucleus whole, binds the DNA bar, and illuminates it bright warm gold-teal labelled 'Genes ON'.
scenes.narration: It spares newly made Gli from cutting. Once Smoothened turns on, kinase marking stops. Cut repressors are never glued back together. Instead, freshly made Gli avoids the proteasome, keeps its activating half intact, and moves into the nucleus whole. There, full-length Gli switches target genes on.

scenes.tts: Compare both states side by side. Without Hedgehog, Patched stays active, Smoothened stays off, and trimmed Glee silences genes. With Hedgehog, Patched turns off, Smoothened turns on, and intact Glee activates them. In short, Hedgehog switches off Patched, letting Smoothened keep Glee whole and active.
scenes.caption: Compare both states side by side. Without Hedgehog, Patched stays active, Smoothened stays off, and trimmed Gli silences genes. With Hedgehog, Patched turns off, Smoothened turns on, and intact Gli activates them. In short, Hedgehog switches off Patched, letting Smoothened keep Gli whole and active.
scenes.visual: Split view built directly from the same cell cross-section (each half fills 70% height, same colours). Left half ('No Hedgehog'): bright coral Patched, dim Smoothened, trimmed deep-violet Gli repressor, Genes OFF. Right half ('+ Hedgehog'): gold Hedgehog plugging dimmed Patched, bright teal Smoothened, intact violet-lavender Gli activator, Genes ON. Gentle continuous particle motion keeps both sides alive.
scenes.narration: Compare both states side by side. Without Hedgehog, Patched stays active, Smoothened stays off, and trimmed Gli silences genes. With Hedgehog, Patched turns off, Smoothened turns on, and intact Gli activates them. In short, Hedgehog switches off Patched, letting Smoothened keep Gli whole and active.

scenes.visual: Clean dark navy end card showing one single centered line in crisp white (size 38), with no smaller subtitle underneath: 'Hedgehog switches off Patched, letting Smoothened keep Gli whole and active.'
